partner.name: Kilimanjaro Nature Tours

whatDoesWhat.ytt: Your Tanzania Trip plans your trip with you, sends the proposal and the invoice, and is your contact before departure.
whatDoesWhat.knt: Kilimanjaro Nature Tours provides the guides, drivers, vehicles, mountain crew, park permits and bookings, and looks after you during the trip.

google._note: reviewUrl: Google Maps listing of Baraka's company with its reviews (owner, 2026-11-23: use the Google and Tripadvisor links for trust). A direct share link from Baraka's Google Business Profile can replace it.

partner.founderBio: Baraka grew up in the Udzungwa Mountains, came to Kilimanjaro as a porter and worked his way up to licensed guide (KINAPA) before founding Kilimanjaro Nature Tours in Arusha. He is certified in Wilderness First Response, teaches first aid and CPR to his crew, and still answers every message himself.
partner.crew: Guides, cooks, drivers and porters, most of them from Arusha and the villages around the mountain. Guides are licensed by KINAPA and trained in Wilderness First Response, first aid and CPR. Porters are hired properly, with fair pay, proper gear and weighed loads, and about 5% of each trip funds schooling in a local village.

forms._note: Form delivery for the static site (public/assets/js/forms.js). FormSubmit sends every submission to the company e-mail; the first submission triggers a one-time activation e-mail that must be confirmed. Activated by the owner on 2026-11-23; requests arrive at bookings@.

story.en: Your Tanzania Trip started on safari. Tijs Krops and Edrian Waterman travelled through Tanzania with Baraka Dalali and his team, and kept in touch after the trip. Out of that contact grew the idea to work together, and in 2025 we started: Your Tanzania Trip plans and books your trip, and Baraka and his team run it in Tanzania as our local partner in Arusha.
story._note: Owner, 2026-11-23: the cooperation began with a safari with Baraka (not an internship) and started in 2025.

analytics._note: Google Analytics 4. The Google tag is in the <head> of every page (BaseLayout.astro) with Google consent mode v2: analytics cookies only after 'Accept' in the cookie banner (public/assets/js/cookie-consent.js); without consent GA receives cookieless pings. Vercel Web Analytics (cookieless) runs independently.
